title: Try RPM CyberCom free for 4 days
changes: Every server can now try RPM CyberCom free for 4 days, once. No card needed. Open /config cybercom and press Try it free for 4 days, or start it at roleplaymanager.xyz/cybercom
The trial has everything: traffic stops and 10-80s by voice, civilians moving by voice, the AI voice dispatcher, transcripts and voice moderation
You get a message the day before it ends. Nothing is charged when it ends: the helper bots leave unless you keep it for $9.99 a month
You can now donate to RolePlayManager at roleplaymanager.xyz/donate and leave a note with it. Donors choose whether their name and note show on the page
Cancelling Premium, moving its key and opening its billing page are now limited to the person who bought it and the server owner. Other admins still see the plan on the dashboard
The Applications webhook setting only accepts a Discord webhook URL
Server names and nicknames with quote marks in them no longer break the dashboard or the server list
